name: Akachi Ony-Elemental|Core+TDL+PtC+EotE|Beginner Deck Guide

name: Akachi - Seal Team (Hard Mode, Guide)

name: William Yorick - Nervous Wrecking Machine (Hard Mode)

name: Yorick Gold Digger|Core+TDL+PtC+EotE|Beginner Deck Guide
summary: Beginner Yorick from Core through Edge of the Earth who digs Baseball Bats and Cherished Keepsakes back out of his discard pile, with Schoffner's Catalogue money and On the Hunt to find enemies.

name: LumberWill|40k Series|Deck Guide
summary: Chainsaw and Runic Axe Yorick who chops through enemies, finds clues through Precious Memento and Well Prepared, and survives on Plucky and Take Heart.

name: [EXPERT True Solo] William 0xp does it all|Deck Guide
summary: Expert true solo level 0 Yorick: Enchanted Blade recharged each time his ability replays it, Flashlight, Evidence! and Scene of the Crime for clues, and Lucky! to cheat the bag.

name: Plowshares to Swords
summary: Straightforward Yorick who takes on most of the combat with Machete, the .45 and Beat Cop, treating his ability as a bonus rather than the plan, with Lantern for free damage.

name: Full Greed Lola Hayes: the InBestigator (Hard) (2+ Players)

name: Lola Hayes Performs Many Miracles
